pages.title: Neural networks
pages.content: Neural networks learn layered representations from training data. Input features flow through hidden layers to an output layer.

pages.title: Confusion matrix
pages.content: A confusion matrix compares predicted labels with actual labels using true positives, false positives, true negatives and false negatives.

pages.title: Precision and recall
pages.content: Precision measures correct positive predictions while recall measures how many actual positives were found.
